MeshParty by Limited Underground is an independent alternative for using both networks from one screen. It is not intended to replace the official MeshCore or Meshtastic apps. We encourage you to use both official apps.
Open a received message’s options to report abuse, block a sender, or mute a supported channel.

By accepting these rules, you agree to follow them when using MeshParty.

• Do not harass, threaten, or target people with hateful or discriminatory content.
• Do not share sexual exploitation, abuse material, or sexually explicit content.
• Do not share illegal content or use the app to arrange illegal activity.
• Do not send spam, scams, or repeated unwanted messages.
• Do not share someone’s private information without their permission.

Use the options on a received message to report abuse. Blocking and muting hide matching messages and alerts in MeshParty on this phone. They have no effect on other apps or radios.
